## How was it checked?

- [ ] `yarn lint` and `yarn build` pass
- [ ] `pytest` passes in `bridge/` (if the bridge changed)
- [ ] Tried it with Apple Music or `--mock` (if it affects what is shown or the audio)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
- [ ] No emojis, and comments are short
- [ ] New code lives in the feature folder it belongs to
- [ ] No personal data: no local paths, emails, tokens or IP addresses
- [ ] No album artwork or other copyrighted media added to the repo
